newsitem.title: USA: Staodyn sees Q4 revs at $5.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Staodyn sees Q4 revs at $5.3 mln.

text.p: Staodyn Inc said it anticipates fourth quarter revenues to be a record $5.3 million, up 13 percent from the year-ago fourth quarter.
The company said revenues for the full 1996 year will be about $19 million, up slightly from 1995.
Net income for the fiscal fourth quarter is expected to be the highest quarterly income since it acquired its retail division in 1992. The company did not elaborate.
Income for the fiscal year is anticipated to be up about 25 percent over 1995.
It said fiscal year results are expected to be released in late January.

The company also said its board authorized the repurchase of common stock in "quantities sufficient to fund stock requirements for employee common stock option exercises." It did not provide details. The shares will be purchased in open market transactions.

"We believe that our common stock is undervalued in the marketplace, and this authorization provides us with an opportunity to fund employee stock option exercises on a nondilutive basis at very attractive prices," said chief executive John South.
Staodyn makes electromedical treatment devices and accessories.
